name: ReplaceDefApp
tagline: 为 iOS 17 集中管理默认 App 与支持的链接操作。
notice: 仅支持 iOS 17.x。已在 iOS 17.3.1 / RootHide 验证导航与欧路旧取词动作；通话、信息尚未真机验证，Rootless 仅完成构建检查。新版专用翻译提供方不保证可用。
description: 将电子邮件、信息、通话、导航、浏览器 App 与翻译选择集中到一个设置页面。
浏览器和邮件使用系统已有默认项；其余功能覆盖支持的外部操作入口，实际能力取决于目标 App 和链接格式。
features: 六项集中设置：电子邮件、信息、通话、导航、浏览器 App、翻译
将支持的 Apple 地图位置、搜索和路线链接分发至高德、百度或 Google Maps
为选中文本调用兼容的取词／文本动作扩展；已验证欧路旧取词动作
通话／信息候选选择与系统恢复选项；测试仅预览
启用开关、链接测试、可复制／导出的诊断页
英文、简体中文、繁体中文设置
compatibility: 仅 iOS 17.0–17.x；不支持 iOS 16 或 iOS 18 及以上
Rootless / RootHide；每包包含 arm64 / arm64e
用户已在 iOS 17.3.1 / Dopamine RootHide 确认导航及欧路取词可用
通话／信息未实测；Rootless 仅构建检查；其他设备和系统小版本仍需验证
usage: 按越狱环境安装对应包，手动 respring 后重新打开设置与来源 App；安装包不自动重启。
进入“设置 → 默认 App”，选择目标 App，再开启默认关闭的分发开关。
浏览器和邮件直接修改系统默认项，关闭开关不会撤回；选择 Safari／邮件恢复。其他分类选择系统恢复项，或关闭分发开关。
导航先测试“仅打开目标地图”，再测试“打开原始链接”，并核对目的地。坐标系选项在测试链接菜单；不支持的格式保留原路径。
翻译需选择兼容的取词／文本动作候选；仅识别到 App 不代表可用。Google 等没有兼容扩展的版本会显示待适配；新版专用提供方不保证可在 iOS 17 运行。
不替换蜂窝来电、SMS/iMessage/RCS 收发或 Safari 整页翻译；不保证所有 App 内置地图和拨号／消息编辑入口生效。
通话、信息测试仅预览，不会拨号或发送。诊断支持复制／导出，不保存 URL、号码、消息正文、位置或翻译原文。

changes: 集中管理 iOS 17 的邮件、信息、通话、导航、浏览器与翻译选择。
支持常见地图链接分发及兼容翻译 App 的选中文本取词。
提供系统恢复选项、测试预览与诊断导出，支持 Rootless / RootHide。

en.name: Default Apps
en.tagline: Manage default apps and supported link actions on iOS 17.
en.notice: iOS 17.x only. Navigation and the legacy Eudic text action were verified on iOS 17.3.1 / RootHide. Calling and messaging remain untested on device; Rootless has build validation only. New dedicated translation providers are not guaranteed to work.
description: Manage email, messaging, calling, navigation, browser and translation choices in one Settings page.
Browser and email use existing system defaults. Other features cover supported external action entry points, with capabilities depending on the target app and link format.
features: Six categories: email, messaging, calling, navigation, browser and translation
Route supported Apple Maps location, search and route links to Amap, Baidu Maps or Google Maps
Look up selected text using compatible text action extensions; the legacy Eudic action has been verified
Calling and messaging choices with system restore options; tests only preview requests
Enable switch, link tests and diagnostics with copy/export
English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese settings
compatibility: iOS 17.0–17.x only; excludes iOS 16 and iOS 18 or later
Rootless / RootHide; each package includes arm64 / arm64e
User confirmed navigation and Eudic lookup on iOS 17.3.1 / Dopamine RootHide
Calling and messaging are untested; Rootless has build checks only; other devices and minor versions require validation
usage: Install the package for your jailbreak environment, manually respring, then reopen Settings and source apps. Installation does not automatically restart the device.
Open Settings → Default Apps, select targets and enable routing, which is off by default.
Browser and email change system defaults directly; disabling routing does not undo them. Select Safari/Mail to restore. For other categories, choose the system restore option or disable routing.
For navigation, test opening the target map first, then the original link, and check the destination. Coordinate options are in the test-link menu; unsupported formats keep their original behavior.

Translation requires a compatible text action candidate. App detection alone does not mean support. Google and other versions without a compatible extension remain unavailable; new dedicated providers are not guaranteed to run on iOS 17.
Does not replace cellular incoming calls, SMS/iMessage/RCS reception or Safari page translation, and does not cover every in-app map, dialer or message editor.

Calling and messaging tests only preview requests without placing calls or sending messages. Diagnostics can be copied/exported and do not store URLs, numbers, message bodies, locations or translation text.

changes: Manage email, messaging, calling, navigation, browser and translation choices together on iOS 17.
Route supported map links and look up selected text using compatible translation apps.
Includes system restore options, test previews and diagnostic export for Rootless / RootHide.
